# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the EXACT tasks you broke/fixed) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — teach the "code re-runs on 3 differing inputs" contract + tighten value/type/placement rules
- Changes I made (1 line per edit):
  - prompt.md §"graded on THREE input files": NEW knowledge — final code is replayed unchanged on 2 hidden inputs (diff data & row counts); forbid hardcoding values, hardcoding preview data-extents, and copying example/"wanted results" tabs; detect extent from the file. Targets HARDCODE cluster (38332, 39046, 51359, 30709, 3911, 5192, 450-9).
  - task_template.md: added the same re-run note up front AND removed the harmful "once that file exists, you are done" line; replaced steps with ordered inspect→solve→verify (step 3 verify = re-open + print answer cells + check type + confirm extent read from file). Structural fix for skipped-verification.
  - prompt.md §"Write final computed VALUES": added WHY (LibreOffice recalc) + names dynamic-array (UNIQUE/FILTER/SORT/SEQUENCE), volatile (RAND/NOW/TODAY), AGGREGATE/array funcs that don't recalc; write literal, esp. "fix my formula" tasks. Targets 47741, 53367 (+57232).
  - prompt.md §"Match value AND type": date/time answers → native datetime + number_format (grader serial); no text sentinels in numeric ranges. Targets 51958.
  - prompt.md data_only line: read formula-cell values via a separate data_only=True copy; never copy "=..." text. Targets 57232.
  - prompt.md §"Touch only the answer cells": write only computed values, no commentary/labels, leave value-less cells blank. Targets CF_11072.
- Expected effect + why safe: primary win is flipping the 6-7 partial-pass tasks (pass 1 of 3) to full pass by killing hardcoding; all edits are ADDITIVE knowledge/contract, and all 24 passing tasks already pass all 3 inputs (⇒ already compute dynamically / write correct types), so reinforcing generality changes none of their outputs. Did not ban simple recalc-able formulas, did not alter any decision/permission rule.
- Building on prior RESULTS: none exist (baseline only). Nothing to avoid re-trying yet.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: several 0/3 are ambiguous/broken ground truth (56996 RANDBETWEEN volatile; 59667/59743 key contradicts instruction; 325-44 non-derivable quirks; 30709 self-inconsistent date key; 56427/57090/50051/55931/110-2 underspecified/formula-anchored). A prompt edit cannot recover these — flagged in PROCESS as skipped. 73-45 is an INFRASTRUCTURE recalc failure (hand back).
- Plateau signal: n/a (first iteration). If this is accepted but flat next time, the remaining failures are mostly ground-truth noise, not a prompt lever — expect diminishing returns and consider that the ceiling here is bounded by ~8-10 ambiguous tasks.
- Focus next iteration: measure which partial-pass tasks flipped; if the hardcode/verify lever landed, look at 11842/56637 over-/under-interpretation and 57232's duplicate-key/#N/A lookup semantics as the next (smaller) cluster.

> **RESULT (framework, objective):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.520 Δ=+0.040 · fixed={353-29, 47741, 51958, CF_11072} · broke={55609, 59259}.
<!-- cand_0001: ACCEPTED val=0.520 Δ=+0.040 -->

<!-- cap-evolve:journal-append-below — add your Iteration entry under this line; do not edit anything above it -->

## Iteration cand_0002 — recover the 2 regressions cand_0001 caused + 5 additive/narrowing fixes across new clusters
- Changes I made (1 line per edit; file + cluster):
  - prompt.md "THREE input files" (NEW paras): "what VARIES (data values + row COUNT) vs FIXED (layout, columns, header rows, named ranges)" — use named anchors directly, don't re-discover positions by content-search; + "existing formulas define the intended computation — read/extend, don't reinvent". Targets REGRESSIONS 55609/59259 + 11842.
  - prompt.md "Write final VALUES" (data_only line + Exception): data_only cache may be stale on hidden inputs → compute from raw source; narrow exception — when expected answer can be an Excel ERROR (#N/A), write a recalc-able live formula so the error TYPE matches. Targets 38332, 57232.
  - prompt.md "Match value AND type": sentinel ban applies only to sentinels the agent INVENTS (honor instruction-prescribed `-`/blank/token); keep zero-padded/code strings as text; strip `\xa0`/whitespace. Targets 59259, 50630, 325-44.
  - prompt.md "Touch only the answer cells": fill every valued cell (no invented dedup/filter blanks); do exactly the op (no invented labels/counts/scheduling); filter/hide = visibility not deletion; "difference from X to Y" = Y−X. Targets 39046, 56637, 110-2, 55931.
  - prompt.md "Finish cleanly": final code must ALWAYS write output_path; guard searches with fallback to task-named positions instead of `raise`. Targets 55609.
  - task_template.md step 3: "done" now requires the MOST RECENT turn to be a verification turn printing value+type of every answer cell; never end on a bare write. Targets 325-44.
- Expected effect + why safe: surest gain is recovering 55609 (crashed → no output; now uses fixed anchor + always-saves) and 59259 (honors "may be '-'" + doesn't over-refactor fixed layout) — both were passing pre-cand_0001. All edits are ADDITIVE or NARROWING of an existing rule; none loosens a global decision/permission. The 26 passing tasks already compute dynamically, write correct types, and fill only valued cells, so reinforcing/narrowing changes no output. Filter=visibility line carved out "unless asked to delete/extract" to spare passing extract tasks.
- Building on prior RESULTS: built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, val 0.520, broke {55609,59259}). I did NOT revert cand_0001's anti-hardcode/sentinel rules (they fixed 353-29/47741/51958/CF_11072) — I NARROWED them so its casualties recover while its fixes hold.
- Refuted hypotheses: none disproven yet (only one prior RESULT). Confirmed-unwinnable this iteration (do NOT chase): 56996 (RANDBETWEEN volatile), 59667/59743 (GT contradicts instruction), 5192 (contradictory examples), 73-45 (infra recalc failure).
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: 450-9 (demo tab ≠ GT, unobservable), 30709 (date-order ambiguity), 51359 (run-length edge), 3911 (blank-count edge) — low leverage / ground-truth-bound.
- Plateau signal: n/a (2nd iteration). If cand_0002 lands flat/negative, remaining headroom is mostly ground-truth noise (~7-8 unwinnable tasks); switch lever to worked-EXAMPLE exemplars for the interpretation cluster rather than more rules.
- Focus next iteration: measure whether 55609/59259 recovered and whether the fill-all/normalization edits flipped 39046/50630/56637; if the filter line regressed anything, drop it.
